reasonForPriority: A source audit found that the immediately preceding rainwater pass had independently introduced DanchiRainwaterDrainage even though the native-4K path already owns a mature authoritative rainwater implementation through QualityBlockRainwaterDownpipeInstallationQA. The benchmark builder creates one RainGutter at the authoritative facade datum, the installation QA reconstructs that body plus HD_RainwaterDownpipeAssembly, and the native-4K packet explicitly applies and repeatedly validates that system. The duplicate used unrelated installation coordinates, attempted to disable legacy RainGutter objects and was not part of the native-4K preparation path. Leaving it in place would create conflicting construction authority and could block or contaminate formal rendering, so correction outranked further speculative detail expansion.
changes: Removed QualityBlockRainwaterDownpipeUpgrade.cs, the duplicate system mutator.
Removed QualityBlockRainwaterDownpipeConstructionQA.cs, whose formal pre-cull requirement depended on the duplicate root.
Removed the duplicate rainwater_downpipe_contract.json and rainwater_downpipe_lookdev.svg so they cannot be mistaken for the formal construction authority.

Added rainwater_system_authority_contract.json declaring Danchi/RainGutter plus Danchi/DanchiHighDetail/HD_RainwaterDownpipeAssembly as the single formal system and binding that authority to the existing installation contract, lookdev and native-4K entry point.

Added QualityBlockRainwaterSystemAuthorityQA.cs. It fails closed if duplicate source/contract files return, if the duplicate scene root exists, if more than one active RainGutter renderer exists, if the authoritative accessory root is missing/moved/inactive, if the macro body still exposes a Unity primitive mesh at formal-render time, or if the native-4K apply/validation tokens drift.

The authority gate is read-only on QA4K, temporal and prepared-temporal culls. Reflection culls are also checked once the authoritative accessory root exists; pre-build editor reflections are not mutated or blocked while the assembly is not yet established.

sourceAuditEvidence.benchmarkBuilder: BuildQualityBlock1990s.BuildDanchi creates exactly one RainGutter at x=4.45, z=-6.55 before high-detail reconstruction.
sourceAuditEvidence.authoritativeInstallation: QualityBlockRainwaterDownpipeInstallationQA reconstructs the RainGutter body at the documented facade datum, creates HD_RainwaterDownpipeAssembly under DanchiHighDetail, uses hollow joint/band/receiver construction, explicit support interfaces and physical material checks, then rebinds the Danchi LOD stack.
sourceAuditEvidence.formalEntryPoint: QualityBlockNative4KReviewPacket calls QualityBlockRainwaterDownpipeInstallationQA.ApplyAndPersist exactly once and QualityBlockRainwaterDownpipeInstallationQA.ValidateOpenScene multiple times before still and temporal evidence.
sourceAuditEvidence.duplicateConflict: The removed DanchiRainwaterDrainage pass used a separate root and unrelated coordinates and disabled RainGutter renderers, which conflicts with the already authoritative formal path.
